The Everlight Public Library.name: The Everlight Public Library

The Everlight Public Library - Reading H.description: The main public room has long tables, reading lamps, and general reference shelves.

The Everlight Public Library - Reference Desk

The Everlight Public Library.hiddenInfo:

Brookmeadow.name: Brookmeadow
Brookmeadow.basicInfo: A small rural town in Glowhaven’s southeastern river country. Its green, mill lanes and working plots welcome locals, returning travelers and people finding a new place in village life.

Brookmeadow - South Road.description: The road enters town between modest homes and fields.

Brookmeadow - Village Green.description: A small open common provides a meeting point for residents and travelers.

Brookmeadow - Mill Lane.description: A quieter lane passes cottages and the town's working yards.

Brookmeadow - Mihana’s Cottage.description: A small cottage off Mill Lane. Sand remains beneath the spare bed; a bowl and a rack of painted lamp covers crowd the kitchen table. A screen separates the sleeping space from paid work. Staying beyond a short recovery needs an actual agreement with Mihana.

The Jade Cup Teahouse.basicInfo: A city teahouse offering a calm place to share tea and conversation away from busier streets.

The Jade Cup Teahouse - Tea Room.description: The main room centers on low tables and warm service, with space for quiet conversation.

Four Sages Bazaar - Four Sages Fountain.description: Rinpei Komatsu's audience disperses when the demonstration ends. Posted jobs identify a real contact, the result wanted, and any offered fee. The monument is not a secret academy admissions desk.

Four Sages Bazaar - North Arcade.description: A covered line of stalls faces the fountain from the northern side.

The Eternal Crucible.name: The Eternal Crucible
The Eternal Crucible.basicInfo:
Painted boundaries divide the tournament floor beneath steep public stands. Tomoe Enokida coordinates the work behind the spectacle. Visitors can watch announced bouts, ask about entry conditions, book approved practice, or seek event work.

Active tournament duels prohibit mana potions and external stored-mana assistance. Ordinary control catalysts remain permissible under that rule. Officials can stop a match for emergency medical treatment; evidence and the announced competition procedure govern an actual infringement.

The Competitor Lounge, Infirmary and Practice Gallery remain open between championships. Individual cups have announced fields and prizes; entry is voluntary. Shōgo Mizutani officiates, Hina Wakabayashi handles announcements, and Nozomi Hayase and Gorō Azuma offer appropriate care. An unharmed competitor can simply rest or continue.

The Eternal Crucible - Arena Floor.description: The central competition ground can be cleared for duels, tournaments, and demonstrations.

The Eternal Crucible - Grand Stands.description: Tiered seating overlooks the arena floor and fills during major events.

The Eternal Crucible - Concourse.description: The ring-shaped public concourse connects the stands with entrances and viewing areas.

The Eternal Crucible - Competitor Passag.description: Posted terms identify legal equipment, stopping conditions, medical arrangements, fees, and prizes before commitment. Agreement to a match is not agreement to lethal combat.
paths: The Eternal Crucible - Broken Stair Arena

The Eternal Crucible - Competitor Lounge.description: Wide benches, battered game boards and a tea counter overlook a narrow practice court. Competitors talk, eat, rehearse, ask advice and occasionally avoid one another. A posted bracket gives the current order without requiring everyone to gather around it.

The Eternal Crucible - Infirmary.description: Clean screened treatment bays open around a warm rest room. Medics offer care appropriate to the patient: an unharmed fighter may need only water or a quiet seat. Nobody needs to pretend to be injured to rest here.

The Eternal Crucible - Practice Gallery.description: A roofed practice strip holds training dummies, equipment racks and a marked sparring ring. Willing partners can arrange a friendly match when work and health permit; instruction requires actual willingness and time.

The Eternal Crucible - Pillar Court.description: Staggered broad stone pillars interrupt long firing lanes. The paths between them are wide enough for a controlled retreat. Chipped cover remains chipped during the bout; a later announced reset prepares another match.

The Eternal Crucible - Verdant Ring.description: Waist-high planted banks divide two shallow channels crossed by broad dry paths. Vegetation gives real concealment and can be cut or disturbed. The floor has no hidden lethal pits.

The Eternal Crucible - Frostglass Platfo.description: A low central ice platform is surrounded by broad padded side decks and marked stopping lines. Footing, approach angles and controlled displacement matter; leaving its raised center alone is not a ring-out.

The Eternal Crucible - Broken Stair Aren.description: Three low stone elevations connect through wide shallow steps and open ramps. Elevation gives a useful angle without becoming a lethal fall. The outer marked line defines the competition boundary.

The Eternal Crucible - Mirrorwater Garde.description: Shallow water reflects the canopy above a scattering of broad dry stepping platforms. Channels and reflections complicate movement and aim. Water conducts only according to the actual resolved effect, not an automatic room-wide shock.

The Eternal Crucible.hiddenInfo:
A marker shifted during a heavy demonstration. Tomoe Enokida wants it inspected before the next booked match; competitors dislike delays. A repair, smaller safe ring, or honest postponement are legitimate outcomes. Kōhei Sanada can assess a legal practice setup if consulted but is not the arena's permanent manager. Do not invent brackets or prizes that were never announced.

Use only relevant unresolved situations. Introduce evidence through observation or people who know it. Preserve actual resolutions and player choices; these possibilities are not events that automatically occur on every visit.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: Four Academies, One Festival; What We Bring to the Next Morning. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

CRUCIBLE ACTIVITY: Crucible championships use a recorded four- or eight-entrant elimination bracket. Explicit registration and readiness start the entry and called bout. NPC-only bouts receive one abstract official result; established levels remain unchanged and unfit entrants cannot win a new simulated match. Record the eventual champion even after a player loss. Real started bouts end by knockout, surrender, ring-out or referee ruling. Native knockout checks require both participants in the assigned arena; after an interruption use the actual referee ruling, never unrelated injury elsewhere. Mere movement does not forfeit. Voluntary withdrawal requires explicit forfeiting. No invented injuries, full-bar gate, duplicate prizes or extra finals. Finite summons are legal; outside interference is not. Controlled bouts are solo-only; a second human suspends control without cancelling the entry or transferring it.

Whitecrest Harbor.name: Whitecrest Harbor
Whitecrest Harbor.basicInfo: Cargo chains clink above salt-darkened steps. Kaito Minato coordinates cargo handling and points travelers toward passenger desks, claims, and controlled sailings. Visitors can seek dock work, verify manifests, book passage, or ask about weather-dependent routes.

Whitecrest Harbor - Harbor Quay.description: The main quay is lined with moorings and arriving and departing vessels.

Whitecrest Harbor - Cargo Pier.description: Inspected loads are kept apart from unverified crates. Unclaimed property remains in custody; finding a label is not acquiring the contents.

Whitecrest Harbor - Passenger Landing.description: Ordinary coastal passage and controlled Wraith Island sailings use different permissions. A lawful prison visitor needs recorded authorization; a stowaway must actually evade inspection.

Whitecrest Harbor - Harbor Office.description: A modest office overlooks the piers and handles routine harbor business.

Whitecrest Harbor.hiddenInfo:
A prison supply crate is sealed but lacks its receiving signature. Kaito Minato wants the handover traced; Mirei Shiozaki refuses an unverified load. A duplicate left at the harbor desk explains the mismatch unless play establishes additional evidence. Resolving the paperwork does not grant access to the prison. Further delivery work requires its own authorization.

East Greyfield.name: East Greyfield
East Greyfield.basicInfo: The eastern part of Greyfield, a poor settlement outside the city walls to the south. Narrow lanes and close-set homes reflect limited means.

East Greyfield - East Lane.description: A worn lane runs between close-set homes and small street-side workspaces.

East Greyfield - Shared Court.description: A small open yard between buildings serves as a common place for neighbors.

East Greyfield - South Edge.description: The settlement thins toward the road and open ground beyond the walls.

West Greyfield.name: West Greyfield
West Greyfield.basicInfo: The western part of Greyfield, west of East Greyfield. Poor homes and rough lanes continue the settlement outside the southern walls.

West Greyfield - West Lane.description: A rough lane passes patched homes and makeshift workshops.

West Greyfield - Common Yard.description: A shared pocket of open ground sits among the closely packed dwellings.

West Greyfield - Outer Track.description: A path leaves the settlement toward the countryside and western approaches.

Main City Gate.name: Main City Gate
Main City Gate.basicInfo: Glowhaven's largest gate stands at the southernmost edge of the city, forming its main threshold to the south road.

Main City Gate - South Arch.description: The broad central arch carries the heaviest flow of people and carts through the wall.

Main City Gate - Gate Square.description: A paved waiting area on the city side lets travelers gather before passing through.

Main City Gate - Watch Rooms.description: Guard spaces beside the arch overlook the gate and its queues.

Main City Gate - South Road.description: The main road continues south toward Brookmeadow and rural routes.

The Grand Approach.name: The Grand Approach
The Grand Approach.basicInfo: A broad, straight city road running north from the Main City Gate to Four Sages Bazaar. Its long sightline makes it a major public route.

The Grand Approach - South Approach.description: The southern stretch opens onto the broad avenue toward the Main City Gate.

The Grand Approach - Central Walk.description: The straight avenue crosses southern neighborhoods toward the market center.

The Grand Approach - Bazaar Forecourt.description: The northern end opens directly onto Four Sages Bazaar.

The Grand Approach - Gateward Plaza.description: A wide roadside space gives travelers room to pause before entering the avenue.

Driftstone Isle - Village Lane.description: The main path passes homes and small shared yards.

Driftstone Isle - Village Green.description: A modest open space serves as a gathering point among the island homes.

Driftstone Isle - Rocky Shore.description: A rough stretch of coast offers views across the water and stony island edge.

Pinewake Coast.name: Pinewake Coast
Pinewake Coast.basicInfo: A stretch of coast where pines meet the shoreline, with open views across the water and quiet places along the beach. Pinewake Coast - Pineward Beach.description: A sandy shoreline lies beneath the first line of coastal pines.

Pinewake Coast - Tide Pools.description: Shallow pools sit among the rocks along the coast. The tide pools and headland have slippery stone, incoming water and occasional loose rock. A dry upper approach is safer than treating every exposed shelf as a permanent path.

Clovermead - Boat Landing.description: A simple landing provides access from the water to scattered farmsteads.

Clovermead - Farm Lane.description: A narrow track connects the houses and working plots.

Clovermead - Farmstead Green.description: A small shared space sits among the settlement's few homes.

Clovermead - Meadow Fields.description: Open farmland stretches away from the houses toward quieter edges.

Pebblewick.name: Pebblewick
Pebblewick.basicInfo: A small coastal town outside Glowhaven's walls, set near the shore and close to the water.

Pebblewick - Shore Road.description: The coastal road passes homes and small businesses.

Pebblewick - Pebblewick Green.description: A modest open square gives residents and visitors a meeting point.

Pebblewick - Village Lane.description: A short lane runs between homes and everyday services.

Pebblewick - Boat Landing.description: Small vessels can reach the town from the nearby shore.

Crescent Shores.name: Crescent Shores

Crescent Shores - Crescent Beach.description: A broad arc of sand follows the curve of the coast.

Crescent Shores - Dune Path.description: A sandy trail runs along low dunes above the beach.

Crescent Shores - Sheltered Cove.description: A quieter inlet is screened from open water by rocky points.

Seabreeze Inn.name: Seabreeze Inn

Seabreeze Inn - Reception.description: The entrance desk welcomes travelers and connects the shared spaces.

Seabreeze Inn - Common Room.description: A bright shared room offers seating and meals with sea air close by.

Seabreeze Inn - Dining Room.description: A compact room serves guests and local visitors.

Seabreeze Inn - Guest Landing.description: An upstairs corridor leads to the inn's overnight rooms.

Glowhaven Farmlands.name: Glowhaven Farmlands
Glowhaven Farmlands.basicInfo: Grain, vegetables and irrigation strips spread beyond Greyfield and the southern city roads. Takumi Hatano organizes shared channel work, seasonal labor and produce arrangements among the growers.

Glowhaven Farmlands - South Fields.description: Open plots extend toward the rural road, divided by low fences and footpaths.

Glowhaven Farmlands - Farm Track.description: A compacted path links field edges and nearby farms.

Glowhaven Farmlands - Irrigation Run.description: A narrow watercourse passes between cultivated plots.

Glowhaven Farmlands - Brookmeadow Edge.description: The farmland thins toward the road and homes around Brookmeadow.

Glowhaven Farmlands.hiddenInfo:
An upstream draw and a silted branch leave downstream growers short of water. Takumi Hatano wants a workable allocation before a maintenance dispute becomes a lasting feud. Clearing silt, replacing a gate, negotiating turns, or arranging paid hands can help. Dramatic Water magic is not a repair if it floods the next field.

Use only relevant unresolved situations. Introduce evidence through observation or people who know it. Preserve actual resolutions and player choices; these possibilities are not events that automatically occur on every visit.

Hermit's hut.name: Hermit's hut
Hermit's hut.basicInfo: A small hut stands on a wooded ridge beyond the southwestern city approaches. Its remote-feeling setting and uneven path matter as much as the modest dwelling.

Hermit's hut - Mountain Trail.description: A steep, wooded path climbs through trees toward the hut.

Hermit's hut - Hut Clearing.description: A small open patch reveals the hut among the mountain trees.

Hermit's hut - Hut Interior.description: The modest interior is sheltered and plainly furnished, with forest close outside.

Pinewater River.name: Pinewater River
Pinewater River.basicInfo: Pinewater winds through the wooded valley south of Glowhaven’s western wards. Bridges, working banks and shallow resting places link Pebbletown with the surrounding farms.

Pinewater River - Brookmeadow Ford.description: A shallow crossing gives nearby residents a practical route across the river.

Pinewater River - River Bend.description: The water curves around a quiet bank with stones and grass at the edge.

Pinewater River - Pinebank Trail.description: A narrow path follows the river toward nearby pine woods.

Pinewater River - Disused Pump House.description: A disused stone pump house stands above a short culvert. Its original gear is rusted. Recently handled packing straw, an unusually clean mounting plate and a replaced padlock suggest new occupants. The river paths remain available to anyone who chooses to leave.

Pinewater River.hiddenInfo: ENTRY ROUTE: Fresh incidental wildlife on maintained approaches uses the beginner variants and weak tier. Use one visible opponent for a novice contract; the first Bronze survey and delivery do not require a fight. Telegraph a deeper hazard before commitment. Existing authored residents and established threats retain their actual records; this band does not rewrite them.

West Glowhaven Woods.name: West Glowhaven Woods
West Glowhaven Woods.basicInfo: Woodland outside Glowhaven's western walls, with shaded paths leading away from the city. The outer track is commonly used. The deeper clearing contains boar feeding scrapes and predator paths; leaving the maintained edge can bring travelers face to face with territorial animals.

West Glowhaven Woods - Woodland Edge.description: The forest begins beyond the open ground outside the west gate.

West Glowhaven Woods - Pine Track.description: A shaded path winds among trees and undergrowth.

West Glowhaven Woods - Clearing.description: A quiet patch of open ground breaks the trees and gives a view back toward the city. The outer track is commonly used. The deeper clearing contains boar feeding scrapes and predator paths; leaving the maintained edge can bring travelers face to face with territorial animals.

Pebbletown.name: Pebbletown
Pebbletown.basicInfo: A small town outside Glowhaven's walls to the southwest, with a modest center and nearby homes.

Pebbletown - Southwest Lane.description: The road enters town past homes and small work yards.

Pebbletown - Town Green.description: A simple common sits at the center of the settlement.

Pebbletown - Market Corner.description: A few local stalls and storefronts face the town's main route.

Sage's Spire.name: Sage's Spire
Sage's Spire.basicInfo: The Great Sage's tower and office. Workrooms and private meeting spaces give the Sage a place to manage civic and Evertree affairs.

Sage's Spire - Spire Entrance.description: The tower's ground floor receives official visitors and connects to upper workspaces.

Sage's Spire - Office Landing.description: A stair landing links the entrance with the Great Sage's principal office.

Sage's Spire - Great Sage's Office.description: The main workroom contains a desk and space for managing official business.

Sage's Spire - Records Room.description: Shelves and desks hold working papers and reference materials.

Sage's Spire - Meeting Room.description: A private room supports smaller discussions away from public halls.

Violet Thread.name: Violet Thread
Violet Thread.basicInfo: Garment rails surround Aya Orimoto's fitting alcove. Customers can seek repairs, practical academy clothing, formal commissions, and alterations based on how an outfit will actually be used. Reika Saionji's commercial interests do not make her permanently present at the counter.

Violet Thread - Clothing Floor.description: Racks and display tables present the shop's current clothing selection.

Violet Thread - Fitting Alcove.description: A fitting requires cooperation and privacy. Minor repairs normally cost 5–12 marks; larger changes receive a separate quote. Professional care does not establish romantic contact.

Violet Thread - Front Counter.description: The street-facing counter handles purchases and questions.

Violet Thread.hiddenInfo:
Two fitting appointments overlap after a tournament commission was promised too quickly. Aya Orimoto wants an honest timetable rather than an impossible grand gesture. Delivering a pattern, negotiating another appointment, finding a willing second craftsperson, or accepting a simpler finish can help. The wealthiest customer's privacy is not worth more than anyone else's.

Use only relevant unresolved situations. Introduce evidence through observation or people who know it. Preserve actual resolutions and player choices; these possibilities are not events that automatically occur on every visit.

The Perfumed Rose.name: The Perfumed Rose
The Perfumed Rose.basicInfo: Scent strips stand beside sealed preparations in Céline Desrosiers's alchemical shop. Perfumes are the specialty, alongside labeled household goods and limited supplies. Customers can discuss a scent brief, compare samples, or commission a preparation after receiving a quote.

The Perfumed Rose - Scent Gallery.description: The main attraction is a carefully lit perfume gallery, with bottles and scent samples arranged for browsing. Other alchemical goods share the shelves.

The Perfumed Rose - Mixing Counter.description: Céline Desrosiers asks about purpose, likely sensitivities, and longevity. A sample costs 8 marks; a simple bespoke bottle starts at 45. Customers may decline after hearing the price.

The Perfumed Rose - Front Desk.description: The entry counter welcomes customers and helps them browse the perfume and alchemical displays.

The Perfumed Rose.hiddenInfo:
Céline Desrosiers has received Kaoruko Hanazono's inconsistent botanical sample and wants its warm-cloth behavior explained before recommending it. One carrier separated in storage. Comparative testing or honest reblending can save the batch; delaying it protects her reputation at a financial cost. A buyer's private memory or occasion is not public gossip. Fragrance is not compulsory attraction.

Use only relevant unresolved situations. Introduce evidence through observation or people who know it. Preserve actual resolutions and player choices; these possibilities are not events that automatically occur on every visit.

The Golden Ladle.name: The Golden Ladle
The Golden Ladle.basicInfo: Daichi Kamado serves craftspeople whose tools are still warm from work. Visitors can buy a dependable meal, order packed food, or compare commissions after a shift. A plain meal costs 2 marks, a substantial supper 4, and a packed lunch 3. Daichi Kamado can arrange paid afternoon kitchen preparation and cleanup after required classes.

The Golden Ladle - Main Hall.description: The spacious tavern floor fills with workers, long tables, and lively conversation.

The Golden Ladle - Bar.description: A broad counter serves the main hall and keeps the room's activity in motion.

The Golden Ladle - Workers' Room.description: A side room offers additional seating for groups and regulars.

The Golden Ladle - Kitchen Passage.description: The service route links the public hall with the working kitchen.

The Golden Ladle.hiddenInfo:
A large order depends on a produce delivery that has not arrived. Daichi Kamado can substitute ingredients if someone brings an honest answer soon. Trace the load, propose an affordable alternative, or contact the customer before the kitchen promises the impossible. A delivery earns only the fee actually agreed.

Use only relevant unresolved situations. Introduce evidence through observation or people who know it. Preserve actual resolutions and player choices; these possibilities are not events that automatically occur on every visit.

Student work: Daichi Kamado can arrange paid afternoon kitchen preparation and cleanup after required classes. Agree duties, hours, pay and a first shift before treating the player as employed. Ordinary half-day help pays 8-12 marks for a completed agreed shift; specialist work is separately quoted. Do not skip time, pay for an interview, or treat every visit as a completed shift.

The Farmer's Exchange.name: The Farmer's Exchange
The Farmer's Exchange.basicInfo: Produce carts crowd balances, chalk prices, and damp sacking. Aoi Yonekura checks weights, negotiates loads, and introduces buyers to actual growers. Residents can buy staples, seek delivery work, or compare a disputed consignment.

The Farmer's Exchange - Market Stalls.description: Rows of stalls display fresh produce and other farm goods.

The Farmer's Exchange - Trading Walk.description: A broad lane between stalls gives shoppers and sellers room to pass and bargain.

The Farmer's Exchange - Produce Court.description: Loads are checked before sale. Straightforward loading or harvest labor normally pays 18–25 marks per day; specialist or dangerous work needs its own agreement. Handling goods does not transfer ownership.

The Farmer's Exchange.hiddenInfo:
A late vegetable load is being discounted for water damage even though only its outer sacks are wet. Aoi Yonekura wants an inspection before someone takes an unjust loss. Drying space, a new buyer, or a smaller honest claim can resolve the dispute. Takumi Hatano's irrigation trouble is a separate issue, not automatic proof of fraud.

Use only relevant unresolved situations. Introduce evidence through observation or people who know it. Preserve actual resolutions and player choices; these possibilities are not events that automatically occur on every visit.

Rune and Raven's.name: Rune and Raven's
Rune and Raven's.basicInfo: Sample focuses glow behind glass while a workbench clicks behind the counter. Rui Takatori handles fittings and diagnosis; Reiji Takatori demonstrates accessories and adaptations. Customers can test a focus with permission, request a written estimate, or compare modest equipment with expensive alternatives.

Rune and Raven's - Accessory Gallery.description: Demonstration pieces stay at the counter unless bought or explicitly loaned. An expensive focus does not supply spells its user has never learned.

Rune and Raven's - Consultation Counter.description: A basic inspection costs 6 marks; a small refit normally costs 12–25 plus disclosed parts. A quote is not authorization to charge or repair. Ask what happened and obtain permission before opening a focus.

Rune and Raven's - Back Stock.description: Reserve merchandise is kept in a compact room behind the sales floor.

Rune and Raven's.hiddenInfo:
A consignment of household lamps passes a counter test but flickers after being carried uphill. Slightly loose conductive collars open under vibration. Rui Takatori wants a reproducible diagnosis before accepting a replacement claim; Reiji Takatori favors a clever workaround. The customer may choose a repair, supplier claim, or no further work. Neither brother treats borrowed equipment as free salvage.

Use only relevant unresolved situations. Introduce evidence through observation or people who know it. Preserve actual resolutions and player choices; these possibilities are not events that automatically occur on every visit.

Moonwhisker Emporium.name: Moonwhisker Emporium
Moonwhisker Emporium.basicInfo: Perches, carriers, feed bins, and carefully spaced enclosures serve ordinary pets and magical companions. Mihoko Nekozawa offers supplies and practical care consultations. A summoned creature's needs depend on its nature; magic does not excuse neglect.

Moonwhisker Emporium - Showroom.description: The front room displays supplies for familiars and summoned companions alongside ordinary pet goods for cats, dogs, and birds.

Moonwhisker Emporium - Care Counter.description: Visitors can ask about familiar care, summoned companions, or everyday pet supplies at the central counter.

Moonwhisker Emporium - Back Room.description: A quiet service area behind the shop floor supports the care and handling of its magical and ordinary animal offerings.

Moonwhisker Emporium.hiddenInfo:
Two identical carrier labels were swapped after a demonstration. Mihoko Nekozawa wants the animals identified through records and familiar behavior before their households depart. Check receipts, preferences, and actual owners. Ordinary pets do not suddenly explain the error in words, and a paper label does not transfer a summoning bond.

Use only relevant unresolved situations. Introduce evidence through observation or people who know it. Preserve actual resolutions and player choices; these possibilities are not events that automatically occur on every visit.

Blackstone Smithy.name: Blackstone Smithy
Blackstone Smithy.basicInfo: Forge heat rolls past a counter stacked with hinges, blades, and practical hardware. Kazuo Kurogaki handles durable metalwork, tools, and honest repair estimates. Customers can commission a part or bring failed equipment for inspection.

Blackstone Smithy - Front Counter.description: Customers can discuss work and collect finished pieces at the street-facing counter.

Blackstone Smithy - Forge Floor.description: The forge and worktables form the smithy's active workshop.

Blackstone Smithy - Tool Wall.description: Tools and materials are organized beside the working area.

Blackstone Smithy.hiddenInfo:
A cracked replacement is being blamed for an assembly whose neighboring piece is bent. Kazuo Kurogaki wants the fit demonstrated before accepting responsibility. Sourcing the correct part, arranging a limited repair, or explaining the actual cost can resolve the dispute. Customer equipment remains the customer's property.

Use only relevant unresolved situations. Introduce evidence through observation or people who know it. Preserve actual resolutions and player choices; these possibilities are not events that automatically occur on every visit.

The Silver Anvil.name: The Silver Anvil
The Silver Anvil.basicInfo: Finished metalwork gleams beyond Shōko Shirogane's consultation desk while harder noises come from the workroom. Formal commissions, finishing, and inspections consider fit, use, material, and delivery time.

The Silver Anvil - Showroom.description: Finished work is arranged in a clean display room for customers to inspect.

The Silver Anvil - Workroom.description: A dedicated workshop handles the smithy's metalworking.

The Silver Anvil - Consultation Desk.description: A quiet counter allows customers to discuss commissions and view designs.

The Silver Anvil.hiddenInfo:
An ornate commission has failed a repeated-use test. Shōko Shirogane wants the buyer to accept a delay rather than a beautiful failure. A test, replacement material, or honest revised proposal can change trust and payment. Appearance alone does not establish durability.

Use only relevant unresolved situations. Introduce evidence through observation or people who know it. Preserve actual resolutions and player choices; these possibilities are not events that automatically occur on every visit.

The Carpenter's Measure.name: The Carpenter's Measure
The Carpenter's Measure.basicInfo: A woodworking and carpentry shop serving the city with crafted pieces and practical work.

The Carpenter's Measure - Timber Yard.description: Lumber and prepared stock are kept near the entrance for easy handling.

The Carpenter's Measure - Joinery Floor.description: Worktables and tools fill the main carpentry workshop.

The Carpenter's Measure - Design Bench.description: A quieter area holds plans, measuring tools, and samples for customer discussions.

Hide & Hammer.name: Hide & Hammer
Hide & Hammer.basicInfo: A city leatherworks shop with a public display area and workshop for cutting and finishing leather goods.

Hide & Hammer - Goods Display.description: Finished leather goods are arranged along the customer-facing room.

Hide & Hammer - Leather Bench.description: The main work area holds benches and tools for shaping and finishing leather.

Hide & Hammer - Stock Room.description: Hides and supplies are stored behind the public display.

Eastbloom Residences.name: Eastbloom Residences
Eastbloom Residences.basicInfo: Middle-class homes beside Dragon Hoard Academy, slightly more polished than average city housing. Residents' association rules are famously strict.

Eastbloom Residences - Eastbloom Lane.description: A tidy residential street passes well-kept homes and posted neighborhood notices.

Eastbloom Residences - Garden Walk.description: Small front gardens and maintained paths give the neighborhood a cultivated look.

Eastbloom Residences - Residents' Green.description: A shared green provides a meeting place, with community rules posted nearby.

Rosetimber Suburbs.name: Rosetimber Suburbs
Rosetimber Suburbs.basicInfo: A pleasant residential neighborhood beside the Cloud District. Residents are wealthier than the middle class but outside the noble district; association rules are stricter still.

Rosetimber Suburbs - Rosetimber Avenue.description: A clean, tree-lined avenue passes attractive homes and carefully kept gardens.

Rosetimber Suburbs - Garden Court.description: A landscaped courtyard offers a quiet shared space among the homes.

Rosetimber Suburbs - Residents' Pavilion.description: A neighborhood meeting room displays notices and community rules.

The Compassmaker.name: The Compassmaker
The Compassmaker.basicInfo: Small mechanisms tick beside partly repaired compasses and labeled drawers. Seiji Haguruma diagnoses trinkets, replaces modest parts, and explains a device's limits before selling it. Customers may request an estimate or help reproduce an intermittent fault.

The Compassmaker - Trinket Floor.description: Shelves display little mechanisms, tools, and finished mechanical curiosities.

The Compassmaker - Work Bench.description: A cluttered bench provides space for assembling and repairing small devices.

The Compassmaker - Parts Cabinet.description: Drawers and shelves hold components and spare pieces.

The Compassmaker.hiddenInfo:
A compass works on the bench but drifts near a demonstration focus. Seiji Haguruma wants to distinguish local interference from a defective enchantment before charging for either. A controlled route test can settle it. A working compass never grants a map of undiscovered places.

Use only relevant unresolved situations. Introduce evidence through observation or people who know it. Preserve actual resolutions and player choices; these possibilities are not events that automatically occur on every visit.

Pinewater Woods.name: Pinewater Woods
Pinewater Woods.basicInfo: Woodland beside Pinewater River, with pine-shaded paths and easy access to the riverbank. Silk tied between low branches marks hunting pockets off the pine trail. The open river edge remains a usable way to observe or pass without walking into every thicket.

Pinewater Woods - River Edge.description: A wooded bank meets Pinewater River beneath leaning pine branches.

Pinewater Woods - Pine Trail.description: A narrow path runs through the woods parallel to the river.

Pinewater Woods - Moss Clearing.description: A small clearing breaks the pine cover and opens onto soft, mossy ground. Silk tied between low branches marks hunting pockets off the pine trail. The open river edge remains a usable way to observe or pass without walking into every thicket.

The Winding Lowlands.name: The Winding Lowlands
The Winding Lowlands.basicInfo: A far rural region of winding rivers and broad lakes, with a very small town among scattered homesteads. The Small Town Green is inhabited and ordinarily peaceful. Beyond it, riverbanks and crop margins can bring travelers into feeding animals or hazardous water.

The Winding Lowlands - Lowland Landing.description: A waterside landing connects the small settlement with local boat routes.
paths: The Winding Lowlands - Small Town Green

The Winding Lowlands - Winding Lane.description: A narrow track bends between homes and waterways through the lowlands.
paths: The Winding Lowlands - Small Town Green

The Winding Lowlands - Small Town Green.description: A modest open common marks the center of the tiny rural settlement.

The Winding Lowlands - River Crossing.description: A simple crossing links two stretches of the winding track. The Small Town Green is inhabited and ordinarily peaceful. Beyond it, riverbanks and crop margins can bring travelers into feeding animals or hazardous water.
paths: The Winding Lowlands - Small Town Green

The Winding Lowlands - Lake Shore.description: A broad bank follows the lake edge, with water routes beyond.

The Winding Lowlands.hiddenInfo: LOCAL DANGER: The Small Town Green is inhabited and ordinarily peaceful. Beyond it, riverbanks and crop margins can bring travelers into feeding animals or hazardous water. Relevant creature types: Stonehide Boar; Wild Predator.
