Undertow Hollows - Pulse Channel.description: The water rises and falls in a measurable interval. Advance observation gives a real opening; a stated interval does not advance the day.

Undertow Hollows - Dry Traverse.description: A broken high shelf bypasses part of the flow at the cost of difficult footing. Its limits are visible before commitment.

Undertow Hollows - Circulation Throat.description: The obstruction and elemental boundary can be examined from cover. Altering flow affects the real chambers, not every lake in the realm.

Heatherwatch Shelf.name: Heatherwatch Shelf
Heatherwatch Shelf.basicInfo:
A weather shelter and hardened landing occupy the western approach to the violet plateaus. Stores, a rescue cache and survey markers support prepared expeditions. The surrounding heath is visible from cover, making this a practical place to judge conditions before crossing into rougher country.

ROUTES: Rimeglass Refuge: the eastern cooperative crossing; Reedglass Anchorage: the southeastern cooperative crossing; Mauvewind Steppe: an open marked approach; Singing Stone Spines: a pale-ridge path. A sky gap requires the stated actual crossing; nearby map pins do not imply connected ground.
Heatherwatch Shelf.hiddenInfo:
A contracted keeper may be present, generated when needed; there is no mandatory named frontier commander. Rescue stores remain communal property. The refuge is not a level gate: a cautious visitor can turn back or hire transport even when nearby wilderness is beyond their ability.

Heatherwatch Shelf - Common Room.description: A plain room offers shelter and agreed resting space. Useful route reports and ordinary conversation can be a complete scene.

Heatherwatch Shelf - Rescue Cache.description: Marked emergency supplies have a real issue and return record. Borrowing a rope is not acquiring an endless inventory.

Heatherwatch Shelf - Heath Lookout.description:
Violet grasses and pale ridges expose movement at a distance. The lookout permits threat assessment before the expedition chooses a route.

Akito Kazamori is the established local guide. He can be extravagant in stories and exact about immediate danger. His Orivelle accounts need evidence; they are not a guaranteed summoning method.

Mauvewind Steppe.name: Mauvewind Steppe
Mauvewind Steppe.basicInfo:
Broad flowering plateaus carry low heather, shallow gullies and scattered rocky spines. Herd paths and predator runs cross the open ground. Surveying growth, recovering shed material and escorting a load are practical jobs here, with broad visibility and limited cover.

ROUTES: Heatherwatch Shelf: an open marked approach; Prismbloom Basin: a sloping mineral shore route; Crownfall Chasm: a southern heath route. A sky gap requires the stated actual crossing; nearby map pins do not imply connected ground.
Mauvewind Steppe.hiddenInfo:
Bramblehorns graze among Glassmane Courser herds. The herbivores defend space and young; the coursers are sharp-edged predators despite their long-legged grazing silhouette. Cropped shrubs, hoof patterns and eye placement can distinguish them. A convoy may change route instead of fighting the whole herd.

Mauvewind Steppe - Western Verge.description: A worn survey marker provides a bearing back toward Heatherwatch before the open steppe.

Mauvewind Steppe - Heath Runs.description: Gullies let a careful party break a charge line. Open magical flight also exposes a traveler to aerial predators.

Mauvewind Steppe - Herd Flats.description: Bramblehorn groups maintain real distances. A warning display can be respected; every grazing animal is not a hostile target.

Mauvewind Steppe - Courser Shelf.description: Glassmane Coursers wait on pale ridges where their segmented mane resembles grass. A flank watcher can detect the deliberate stillness before a rush.

Singing Stone Spines.name: Singing Stone Spines
Singing Stone Spines.basicInfo:
Tall pale stone blades form narrow passages and natural resonating chambers. Wind produces changing notes rather than a constant song. The formations matter to acoustic research and precision enchantment, while their broken passages reward route planning.

ROUTES: Heatherwatch Shelf: a pale-ridge path; The Inverted Crown: a prepared crossing followed by a high ridge. A sky gap requires the stated actual crossing; nearby map pins do not imply connected ground.
Singing Stone Spines.hiddenInfo:
Hushbell Carapaces and Chimeback Striders occupy different sound niches. Certain missing notes identify a carapace rather than a damaged rock. A field team can compare tones, isolate a blocked passage or gather a permitted loose shard without smashing the formations into a weapon supply.

Singing Stone Spines - Windward Mouth.description: Open grass gives way to stone corridors. A reference tone and return bearing can be recorded here.

Singing Stone Spines - Resonance Lanes.description: Wind speed and visible geometry explain most changes. The lanes do not magically know a visitor’s secrets or demand a spoken password.

Singing Stone Spines - Strider Court.description: Chimeback Striders brace tripod legs around a ringing backplate. They telegraph a pulse by lifting the plate; broken sightlines and interrupted resonance offer counterplay.

Singing Stone Spines - Quiet Pocket.description: A local patch of silence may reveal a Hushbell Carapace. Observation or a detour can preserve the acoustic survey.

Prismbloom Basin.name: Prismbloom Basin
Prismbloom Basin.basicInfo:
Mineral pools collect beneath violet flowering banks, leaving iridescent crust and clear growth. Local light makes shallow surfaces look deeper and close ledges seem farther apart. This is a valuable fieldwork site for material quality, optical effects and habitat study.

ROUTES: Mauvewind Steppe: a sloping mineral shore route. A sky gap requires the stated actual crossing; nearby map pins do not imply connected ground.
Prismbloom Basin.hiddenInfo:
Prismfold Fans turn their jointed translucent bodies toward the sun, while Petalglass Snails graze the margins. The fans’ refraction can mislead a rush but is not reality manipulation. Polarized shade and changing the viewing angle expose the real body. Loose cast-off plates are a valid procurement target.

Prismbloom Basin - Mineral Shore.description:
A stable bank permits control samples and separate containers for similar-looking deposits.

Orivelle visits the mineral shore on its circuit’s fourth day. Preserve the actual animal’s condition and wary behavior; its arrival does not complete a separate research quest.

Prismbloom Basin - Fan Beds.description: Prismfold Fans hold several paired membranes above a low segmented body. Their moving shadow and repeated hinge angles reveal where they actually are.

Prismbloom Basin - Bloom Banks.description: Flower roots stabilize the slope. Taking every plant destroys the bank and violates any limited collection agreement.

Prismbloom Basin - Clear Pool.description: A clear pool offers an undisturbed comparison. It provides evidence, not a universal heal or Mana restoration.

Crownfall Chasm.name: Crownfall Chasm
Crownfall Chasm.basicInfo:
A deep fault cuts one of the southern violet islands, exposing mineral bands, ledge paths and wind tunnels. Broken observation gear remains on an accessible shelf. Rescues, instrument retrieval and structural surveys can be attempted without treating the entire abyss as a dungeon entrance.

ROUTES: Mauvewind Steppe: a southern heath route; Stillstar Sanctum: a carrier-assisted ledge crossing. A sky gap requires the stated actual crossing; nearby map pins do not imply connected ground.
Crownfall Chasm.hiddenInfo:
Veilhook Ray flocks ride the chasm lift. Their ventral hooks catch cliff growth and unsecured gear; a snatched bag can remain on a reachable ledge rather than disappear forever. A measured route and visible tether plan can avoid a fight in open air. Falls use actual resolution and available recovery.

Crownfall Chasm - Broken Station.description: An old field station contains damaged instruments and a sheltered landing. Salvage needs actual authority; the wreckage is not automatically abandoned ownership.

Crownfall Chasm - Lift Ledges.description: Veilhook Rays rise along predictable currents. Cover and secured loads matter more than a reckless jump toward the nearest silhouette.

Crownfall Chasm - Lower Shelf.description: A solid shelf permits a bounded recovery task and a real ascent back out. Do not invent a second realm beneath the chasm.

Stillstar Sanctum.name: Stillstar Sanctum
Stillstar Sanctum.basicInfo:
A low ruined survey sanctuary lies among pale ridges. Enclosed calibration rooms, a roofless court and a buried work chamber occupy one compact ruin. Visitors can document its optical instruments and seek a permitted component while preserving the remaining record.

ROUTES: Crownfall Chasm: a carrier-assisted ledge crossing. A sky gap requires the stated actual crossing; nearby map pins do not imply connected ground.

Adventurer's Guild - Glowhaven Branch.name: Adventurer's Guild - Glowhaven Branch
Adventurer's Guild - Glowhaven Branch.basicInfo: A welcoming timber-and-stone guild hall serves adventurers and clients in Glowhaven City. Honey-colored beams, teal-and-ochre tiles and warm geometric stained glass frame a substantial reception counter, rank-tabbed request boards and communal tables. Komugi Hanabishi handles the front desk. Side rooms support appraisals, briefings and records, with a controlled practice yard at the rear. Sword carriers, shield users and spellcasters all have reason to visit.
Adventurer's Guild - Glowhaven Branch.hiddenInfo:
This is the international Adventurer's Guild's court-permitted Glowhaven branch. Use Komugi Hanabishi at reception rather than inventing a replacement clerk. Other actual roles may be filled when needed, but she is not every assessor, healer or specialist. The hall is normally safe and does not spawn combat because it serves adventurers.

Use the actual exam and badge triggers. Registration starts an application; Bronze is granted only after judgment and a resolved practical test are certified. The stated reward is paid in full; do not narrate or deduct a further guild commission. A completed guild contract grants one Guild Service Credit; unrelated quests do not. Reusing a completed contract does not create another payment. Accepting a foreign job never issues court portal keys.

The branch currently uses five credited jobs for a Silver review, ten further credits for Gold and twenty further credits for Platinum. Appropriate judgment, actual work at the required responsibility and an accepted assessment still matter. These are branch review thresholds, not character-level gates. Strong newcomers can request a prompt fair assessment; strength is not an offense. The recognized ranks are Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum.

Ordinary pleading does not tame her; retreat and a prepared party are sensible. A real defeat or effective exclusion ends this finite contract. Merely reaching a hollow or surviving a glance does not. The associated voluntary undertaking is Akitsuhara Guild: Hagire among the Cedars.

Hinoki Hollow Onsen.basicInfo: Warm mineral water rises beneath a low cypress bathhouse at the wooded edge of Benitsuru. A covered washing court, small quiet pools and a garden rest veranda offer a break from the capital. A basic bath and clean towel cost 6 marks. A short maintained lane leads toward South Gate Caravan Yard.

The Gilded Albatross.name: The Gilded Albatross
The Gilded Albatross.basicInfo: An ornate but hard-used sailing ship rides at a charted anchorage. Its butterfly-winged captain takes salvage work and agreed voyages, while crew members mend gear, cook and argue over their shares. Passage, employment and joining an expedition are separate arrangements.

The Gilded Albatross - Quarterdeck.description: A broad rail overlooks the sails and sea. Reina Kazehara discusses routes and terms here when she is not needed elsewhere.

The Gilded Albatross - Crew Passage.description: Cabin doors and hammocks line a narrow, airy passage. Visiting passengers receive an agreed berth; other cabins remain private.

Splinterwake Wreck.name: Splinterwake Wreck
Splinterwake Wreck.basicInfo: A broken merchant hull lies among sharp eastern rocks. Low water exposes cargo spaces, but the approaches bear gouges far below the tide line. Large disturbances sometimes move through the surrounding water; an ordinary salvage trip need not challenge their source.

Splinterwake Wreck - Broken Deck.description: Tilted planks and snapped ribs rise above the water. Lashings, safe footing and the changing tide matter more than speed.

Splinterwake Wreck - Flooded Hold.description: Cold water covers loose cargo and low beams. Air, light and an actual way back are necessary for diving.

Splinterwake Wreck - Deepwater Edge.description: The reef drops suddenly into dark water. Broad suckered marks on timber and unnatural swells warn of a great predator’s passing.

Moonarch Isle.name: Moonarch Isle

Moonarch Isle - Broken Arch.description: One stone span still stands above cracked paving. Its surviving carvings reward patient copying rather than force.

Moonarch Isle - Tide Crypt.description: A shallow undercroft opens from the lower foundations. Water stains mark when its passages become unsafe.

Moonarch Isle - Offshore Drop.description: Beyond the sheltered landing, the bottom drops into dark water. Heavy swell and broad marks on driftwood warn of deepwater animals.

Stillback Isle.name: Stillback Isle
Stillback Isle.basicInfo: A vast shell rests so quietly among the low rocks that it resembles part of the island. Mauruun grazes, sleeps and watches the water with immense patience. Fishers give the creature room and know better than to mistake stillness for helplessness.

Stillback Isle - Quiet Landing.description: A small sheltered beach lies away from the creature’s head. Boats can land without stepping onto its resting ground.

Stillback Isle - Shell Garden.description: Weathered plates hold weed, harmless shell life and patches of old fishing line. The creature’s breathing shifts the ground beneath anyone who climbs aboard.

Stillback Isle - Nesting Shelf.description: Warm sand and low rocks form a protected resting shelf. Mauruun reacts strongly to harassment, injury or disturbance here.

Greenrush Estuary.name: Greenrush Estuary
Greenrush Estuary.basicInfo: Reed channels and pale sandbars divide the river’s meeting with the sea. Working skiffs follow changing water marks between the marsh and the coast. Fish traps, nesting birds and stranded debris offer ordinary work as well as reasons to explore.

Greenrush Estuary - Skiff Landing.description: Daisaku Minobe’s timber supports hold small boats above the mud. Repairs and passage are arranged before a hull is taken.

Greenrush Estuary - Reedwalk.description: Raised footing follows a shallow channel where birds nest and fish flash beneath reeds.

Greenrush Estuary - Sandbar Crossing.description: The exposed bar offers a short route at low tide. Wet stakes and drift lines show how quickly its character changes.

Greenrush Estuary - Field Shelter.description: Sample jars, drying nets and a weather board crowd a modest covered workbench.

Thistlebank Alchemy Cottage.name: Thistlebank Alchemy Cottage
Thistlebank Alchemy Cottage.basicInfo: A low rural cottage smells of bruised herbs and warm copper. Thistlebank Alchemy Cottage - Copper Wor.description: A sturdy bench carries labeled jars, a condenser and a basin for safely cooling mixtures.

Thistlebank Alchemy Cottage - Herb Plot.description: Raised beds grow ordinary useful plants alongside a few temperamental magical specimens.

Wrenhill Windmill.name: Wrenhill Windmill
Wrenhill Windmill.basicInfo: The windmill turns above scattered grain plots on Brookmeadow’s western approach. Old Southwatch.name: Old Southwatch

Old Southwatch - Keeper’s Room.description: A stove, bedroll and carefully maintained tools occupy the lower room.

Old Southwatch - Lookout Walk.description: The upper walk overlooks the forest edge and open plain. Damaged masonry limits where it is safe to stand.

Bluecoil Rest.name: Bluecoil Rest
Bluecoil Rest.basicInfo: A great blue serpent sleeps across a remote reef, its body half hidden by clear water. Bluecoil Rest - Scale Shore.description: A narrow wash gathers naturally shed scales and drift. Fresh drag marks warn when the serpent has recently moved.

Bluecoil Rest - Serpent Ledge.description: The immense animal’s head and coils occupy the inner rocks. The ledge is its resting place rather than an ordinary landing.

Beaconrest Lighthouse.name: Beaconrest Lighthouse
Beaconrest Lighthouse.basicInfo: A red-capped offshore lighthouse guides boats through Whitecrest’s outer channels. Kōzō Hinoura keeps its light and stores in order with help from Saki Hinoura. Visiting crews bring supplies, repairs and more gossip than either keeper admits enjoying.

Beaconrest Lighthouse - Supply Jetty.description: A low jetty receives deliveries when the channel is usable.

Beaconrest Lighthouse - Keeper’s Kitchen.description: Tea, charts and a drying rack share a warm little room beside the stores.

Beaconrest Lighthouse - Lantern Room.description: Polished lenses surround a maintained light assembly. Its working parts are handled with the keepers’ permission.

Beaconrest Lighthouse - Signal Balcony.description: Colored shutters and flags face the harbor approaches.

Starlark Abbey.name: Starlark Abbey
Starlark Abbey.basicInfo: White stone and a small bell tower rise above the southern river. The abbey is devoted to Avelune, Lady of Returning Light, and combines worship with a working hospice, gardens and guest rooms. Visitors need not share the faith to receive ordinary welcome or care.

Starlark Abbey - Pilgrim Court.description: Travelers wait beside a water basin and a shaded bench while attendants arrange beds or introductions.

Starlark Abbey - Chapel of Returning Lig.description: Lamps burn beneath a pale star-and-lantern image. Prayer and ceremony have their own rhythms beyond the day’s work.

Starlark Abbey - Hospice.description: Clean linen, screens and herb-scented water surround a small number of beds. Patients are people with privacy, not an audience for every visitor.

Starlark Abbey - Kitchen Garden.description: Useful herbs and vegetables grow along narrow paths watched over by Eiji Kuramochi.

Starlark Abbey - Guest Wing.description: Plain rooms and a shared table shelter pilgrims, workers and people recovering from a difficult journey.

Gullwatch Reefs.name: Gullwatch Reefs
Gullwatch Reefs.basicInfo: Low eastern reefs support nesting seabirds and pools bright with small marine life. Fishers know the usable channels and places to collect modest materials. Slippery stone and an incoming tide can turn an easy outing into a practical rescue.

Starward Commandery.name: Starward Commandery
Starward Commandery.basicInfo: A working paladin chapterhouse stands beside the sacred terrace, with a plain gate court, practice yard and field chapel. Ivory plate is repaired here between ceremonial duties. The order serves the crown and the celestial faith; its members do not always agree about what either service requires.
